name: Dr. S. Kulkarni
review: Remarkable conversational grounding. Tested against 450 historical chat turns; zero cross-persona leakage observed and unknown factual queries correctly triggered the conservative fallback instead of hallucinations.
suggestions: Consider exposing the confidence score of retrieved memory chunks in the chat metadata panel.

name: Priya Sharma
review: The voice continuity in hands-free mode feels very natural. Edge TTS and Groq Whisper latency is sub-second which makes real-time speaking seamless.
suggestions: Add an option to toggle between British and Indian English TTS accents.

name: Rahul Verma
review: The linguistic style extraction captured my friend's Hinglish vocabulary and typing rhythm accurately. The 3D memory orb reactive animations add good visual immersion.
suggestions: Support direct drag-and-drop for audio voice samples on mobile browsers.
